# ChatOSS v0.9.1

**Fixes cloud sign-in on Linux and Windows.**

In v0.9.0, signing in to your ChatOSS account silently failed on Linux (and would fail on Windows): after signing in successfully in the browser, the app stayed signed out. The `chatoss://` custom URL scheme was never registered with the OS, so when the browser tried to hand the session back to the app via `chatoss://auth?code=…`, the OS had no handler and silently did nothing.

## What's fixed

- **Deep-link scheme registration** — the app now calls `register_all()` at launch on Linux + Windows to register the `chatoss://` scheme with the OS (writes a `.desktop` file on Linux, registry entries on Windows). macOS already worked (the scheme is baked into `Info.plist` at build time).
- **Single-instance routing** — added `tauri-plugin-single-instance` (with the deep-link feature) as the first plugin. On Linux/Windows a deep link launches a new process; this plugin routes the URL to the already-running instance and fires the `deep-link://new-url` event there, then focuses the main window. Without it the URL went to a throwaway second instance and the sign-in never reached the real app.

---

Download the installer for your platform below.

**macOS:** download the signed + notarized `ChatOSS_0.9.1_x64.dmg`
**Windows:** `ChatOSS_0.9.1_x64-setup.exe` or `ChatOSS_0.9.1_x64_en-US.msi`
**Linux:** `ChatOSS_0.9.1_amd64.AppImage` or `.deb` or `.rpm`
